name: @superinstance/quilt-neighbourhood
description: Diff-DAG convergence for Quilt sheets — replicas partition, diverge, and rejoin to one deterministic revision. v0.2.0 adds P5 numeric merge (canonical-order mean) and the trained-replica experiment: weight averaging is byte-exact and semantically valid within one loss basin. v0.3.0 adds DID-signed diffs: Ed25519 signature over the diff id, did:key authorship, signed sheets reject unsigned or forged diffs with receipted rejections while revisions stay value-pure.
